description: Corrections applied by experiments/f2_rerun_summary.py to the F2 rerun (MSR 2027 revision, 25-26 Nov 2026). The raw CSVs in experiments/results/f2_rerun are never edited. Only harness errors are corrected, never model outcomes: 'success' when the benchmark criterion (CI green on the fix commit) is met in the log before the harness failed; 'drop' when the run stopped before an outcome existed (the case leaves the comparison of that model, in both arms); 'router' only fills in the Router decision recorded in the log of an error/timeout row. 'router_category' on any correction sets router_category and recomputes router_correct.

corrections.reason: harness error after a successful repair: CI green on the fix commit at attempt 1, then PR creation failed with GitHub 422 'A pull request already exists' (POST retried by PyGithub's default GithubRetry)
harness error: GitHub 422 'Reference update failed' while creating the attempt-2 fix branch; the run stopped before attempt 2 reached the CI, so its outcome is unknown
timeout row without the Router decision: the log records Router -> DEPENDENCY (misrouted, router_correct stays 0); outcome unchanged (failure)
